title: Secure first partner; agree population/stage/topic + distribution + feedback
context: All M2 and M3 tasks depend on a secured partner clinic or advocacy organization. Without a partner, QPL sets cannot reach 'shipped' (adopted and given to patients). This is the gating task for M2: the Steward (named by end of M1 in qpl-reviewers-002) leads outreach to candidate clinic/advocacy organizations; on confirmation, all downstream tasks update their requestor field and verifiedNeed to true. A pause/decision point applies: if no partner is secured by end of M1, the maintainer must make an explicit go/pivot/hold decision before authorizing further set work. The partner agreement must include a PII-safe feedback method — no patient data reaches Elyos.
objective: Secure a named clinic or advocacy organization as the first requestor: confirm the partner in writing, agree on the target patient population, journey stage(s), and topic priorities, define the distribution channel, and establish a PII-safe patient feedback method; record the partnership in-repo and update related tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: A named clinic or advocacy organization is confirmed in writing (email or MOU) as the first requestor; confirmation is referenced in the PR (document stored out-of-band, never committed in full to the repo)
The agreed population, journey stage(s), and topic priorities are documented in-repo in docs/partner-brief.md (no PII; organization name is public once they consent to it)
The agreed distribution channel is documented: how the partner will give QPL sets to patients
A PII-safe patient feedback method is agreed and documented: feedback stays with the partner; only aggregate, de-identified summaries (if any) are shared with Elyos
The pause/decision point is honored: if no partner is confirmed by end of M1, the maintainer's go/pivot/hold decision is recorded in docs/partner-brief.md before any further set work proceeds
On completion, the Steward updates qpl-sets-003 and qpl-delivery-001 with the confirmed requestor and sets verifiedNeed to true on those tasks
resources: PLAN.md (Open questions #2 — partner; Partner/requestor section; M2 exit criteria)
TASKS.md (qpl-partner-001 row and AC; M2 definition of done)
docs/reviewer-onboarding-summary.md (qpl-reviewers-002 — Steward must be named first)
PLAN.md (outreach target types: hospital cancer-centre patient-education depts, disease-specific foundations, national cancer charities, patient-navigator programs, community oncology clinics)
output: docs/partner-brief.md (population, stage, topics, distribution, feedback method; no PII); partner confirmation referenced in PR
